brief:
Met Police have closed their investigation into a social media post by Sarah Helm, wife of a Prime Minister's adviser, according to Al Jazeera English. The force determined that her X post, which appeared to endorse Palestine Action, "does not meet the criminal threshold" for prosecution.

Helm's post had drawn scrutiny over potential support for the activist group, which has staged demonstrations at weapons manufacturers' facilities. The police decision means no criminal charges will be pursued in connection with the online content.
dek: Met Police determine X post by Sarah Helm, seen to endorse Palestine Action, does 'not meet the criminal threshold'.
title: UK police drop probe into PM adviser's wife Palestine Action post
